Herzog three-minimal-generator symmetry criterion restricts possible gluing to a nontrivial pair gcd and remaining scaled membership. Pair (A,B) leaves n=3 versus 7; pair (B,C) none; outer pair d∈{5,7,35} bounded by explicit sum-of-coefficients inequalities to n<11,15,71, respectively, and congruence exclusions leave n=40. The relation 2501=7·68+27·75 proves n=40. Independent exact Apéry Dijkstra computations for all 2≤n≤124 confirm only 2,3,5,40 and reproduce each exact F and genus. The universal exclusion is algebraic, not inference from this finite check.
